F_bp.note: mean read-1 length (FastQC per-read row, else the single-end sample row)

Q30Percent.note: fastp's base-level Q30 rate, written as a percentage by MultiQC

MappedPercent.note: only when --tools runs a STAR-based caller on FASTQ input

DuplicationPercent.note: GATK4 MarkDuplicates, parsed by MultiQC's picard module

rRNAPercent.note: Picard counts aligned bases, not reads, in rRNA
